claims.after: The pilot is only a directional spending guard: it may advance the fixed-N confirmation only when D, W_P, and L_terminal jointly satisfy the registered four-root conjunction; it supplies no inferential or SESOI claim.
claims.before: A pilot could advance on D positivity alone, which can occur while parented writes are harmful or P1 does not improve over entry.
claims.evidence_needed: Frozen pilot rule, all-root pilot receipt, validity/resource receipts, and prebound adverse-bound receipt.

claims.after: A passing confirmation D followed by W_P and L_terminal supports only that this fixed reset parent policy increased this fixed child system's beneficial later personal-write effect over Q after parent/nursery deletion.
claims.before: The project motivation could be read as broad parenting, general learning-to-learn, writer superiority, or LoRA discovery.
claims.evidence_needed: All fixed-sequence confirmation evidence, deletion/provenance gates, root-level uncertainty, and independent review.

claims.after: Writer-path quantities are transparent post-treatment mechanism decomposition, not causal adjustment variables.
claims.before: No v3-specific receipt requirement prevented later yield-conditioned reinterpretation.
claims.evidence_needed: Frozen receipt table, analysis DAG audit, and complete arm-by-cut reporting.

claims.after: P1 versus R0 remains a deployment-only-parity full-package comparison; it neither establishes parenting causality nor discovery, a graph in LoRA, compression, broad meta-intelligence, or named-method superiority.
claims.before: The public two-agent illustration risks being mistaken for the causal parenting result.
claims.evidence_needed: Registered factorial sequence and active-text certification evidence where the word strong is used.

edges.after: Requires D>0 AND W_P>0 AND L_terminal>0 jointly in >=3/4 roots, positive means for all three, all validity/resource gates, and no ratified adverse-bound crossing.
edges.before: Advanced when D>0 in >=3/4 roots and mean(D)>0.
edges.rationale: Prevents a relative write-harm interaction from funding an improved-learning confirmation.

edges.after: Immutable arm-by-cut post-treatment receipt table is reported; it has no edge into matching, adjustment, stratification, exclusion, or a replacement primary.
edges.rationale: Makes the likely writer-alignment pathway inspectable without conditioning causal inference.

edges.after: Forbidden analysis edge; receipt fields cannot alter D, W_P, L_terminal, the pilot cohort, or confirmation cohort.

nodes.after: Directional-conjunction pilot spending gate with retained all-root reporting and separately ratified adverse bounds.
Pre-identity frozen arm-by-cut mechanism-decomposition receipt table.
nodes.before: No required v3 writer-path receipt node.
nodes.rationale: Expose treatment-mediated writer throughput and failures without changing the estimand.

human_boundary.decision_question: Whether to ratify the exact source bytes and narrow v3 scope: retain the one-parent/one-child v1/v2 topology and adopt only the directional pilot conjunction and reporting-only writer-path receipts.
forbidden_before_approval: Any code edit, task/target generation, model or tokenizer call, parent interaction, adapter fit or mount, CompilerGym execution, external scientific execution, GPU use, resource acquisition, or scientific claim.
Changing v1/v2 topology, roster, endpoint, fixed-N design, margin, plateau composite, diagnostic, or resource ceiling beyond this narrow v3 delta.
Selecting adverse pilot bounds, receipt fields, missingness rules, or claim goalposts during implementation.
Using pilot results, writer yields, or P1-R0 as confirmation evidence or as a substitute for the fixed sequence.

loops.after: For each prebound pilot root, compute D, W_P, L_terminal and validity/resource/adverse-bound status; after all four roots, issue only advance/no-advance and preserve all raw rows.
loops.rationale: Adds the minimal directional guard without altering the scientific root topology.
loops.stop_condition: All four assigned roots are complete or administrative missingness triggers the frozen no-advance disposition.
loops.trigger: Completion of the four excluded pilot roots.

loops.after: At every arm/cut, append the frozen writer-path receipt fields; after root lock, report them only as unadjusted decomposition.
loops.before: Writer-path receipt lifecycle was not required by v3.
loops.rationale: Shows how parent-conditioned childhood and later life affect admissible writing without granting receipts causal control.
loops.stop_condition: Receipt schema complete for every prebound arm/cut; no post-identity mutation.
loops.trigger: Each admission, rehearsal fill, fit, mount, rollback, adapter-off check, and cut evaluation.

summary: Faithful narrow v3 repair: preserve the reset target-blind one-parent/one-child Think--Dream--Sleep factorial and replace only the pilot’s D-only spend rule with a D/W_P/L_terminal directional conjunction while freezing writer-path receipts as reporting-only post-treatment decomposition.
system_thesis: A complete organism—not its LoRA alone—acts, thinks, retrieves, dreams, writes, and is evaluated. Lived action/outcome episodes create immutable public evidence; DREAM locally re-expresses and reconciles the child’s live state; deterministic SLEEP selects supported child-native continuations and transports them through one personal LoRA; goal-conditioned retrieval, composition, planning, and revision occur during later THINK through the complete child-plus-active-text system. A reset, target-blind parent may teach process discipline only during childhood and then disappears. Later thinking and outcomes feed future DREAM/SLEEP cycles, but the headline credits the fixed parent protocol only through the root-level P/U-by-write interaction, never credits LoRA transport with discovery, and treats P1-R0 only as a full-package illustration.
title: One-parent/one-child headline v3: directional pilot spending guard and writer-path receipts
